name: Daisy Chen
research_proposal_title: Reuse-Aware Routing for Energy-Efficient AI Inference on Heterogeneous GPUs
proposal_comment: Focusing on prefix caching dynamics across heterogeneous GPU architectures addresses an urgent efficiency bottleneck in multi-turn agentic inference. Literature synthesis integrates recent systems research effectively, particularly regarding FREESH and GreenCache. Hardware scoping remains somewhat limited by testing only two GPU models, specifically the RTX 3090 and H800. Broaden the empirical testbed to include mainstream datacenter cards such as the L4 and A100 to assess whether cache migration tradeoffs hold across varying memory bandwidth tiers. The carbon routing policy assumes known or easily predicted output token counts, so incorporate explicit sensitivity analysis for token estimation variance under bursty agent workflows.
presentation_comment: Delivery is articulate and confident, communicating complex system-level tradeoffs with commendable technical clarity. Visual diagrams explain the mechanics of local versus assisted KV transfer cleanly. Certain testbed slides contain heavy textual lists that could be converted into workflow diagrams or timing traces. Elaborate more specifically on the physical interconnect limitations during KV transfer, because link bandwidth across heterogeneous nodes often dictates whether migration yields a net energy reduction.

name: Michael Wang
research_proposal_title: MetaKV: Prompt-Adaptive Selection of KV Cache Compression Methods for Resource-Constrained LLM Inference
proposal_comment: Prompt feature engineering requires deeper elaboration, as relying on basic text metrics like token length and diversity may fail to capture semantic complexity or attention dispersion in long contexts. Offline profiling is conducted exclusively on a single GPU configuration and single model size, which restricts empirical claims about generalizability. Incorporating cross-model transferability analysis and testing attention entropy as a predictor feature would substantially strengthen the selection framework.
presentation_comment: Vocal pacing is overly uniform throughout the middle slides, reducing audience engagement during the architectural pipeline walkthrough. Concrete examples demonstrating how an actual prompt traverses the LightGBM classifier filters would make the tiebreaker logic much easier to digest. Include explicit runtime benchmarking for feature extraction and meta-model inference to prove that the routing overhead does not negate latency savings.

name: Le Hoang Minh Quan
school: Le Quy Don High School for the Gifted, Da Nang
research_proposal_title: Evaluating Frozen FlyVis Representations for Letter Recognition under Limited Labels and Visual Corruption

Verbal delivery fulfills the mandatory declaration and outlines the experimental timeline accurately. Vocal cadence remains somewhat flat across sections, which reduces audience engagement during complex statistical explanations. Adding visual illustrations of the actual corrupted letter glyphs and BoxEye receptor arrays would make the methodology considerably more intuitive.

name: Aiden Yun
research_proposal_title: Forecasting Solar Ramps from Unlabeled Sky Video: Occlusion-Aware Masked Autoencoders for the Power Grid’s Hardest Forecast Horizon
proposal_comment: Formulates an ambitious and well-reasoned application of self-supervised video masked autoencoders to solar irradiance nowcasting. Addressing sun-blocker hardware artifacts through occlusion-aware masking is a practical contribution for mining legacy sky archives. To strengthen the work, detail the exact computational requirements and hardware setup necessary for VideoMAE pretraining on high-cadence video archives. Specify how real-time inference latency will be handled on edge devices at solar power plants. Explicitly define statistical significance tests to confirm whether improvements over baseline models like SUNSET and SkyGPT are statistically meaningful.
presentation_comment: Delivers a competent explanation of the architectural motivation and data pipeline. The cadence of the narration remains somewhat uniform throughout, which flattens the distinction between high-level motivation and technical mechanics. Slide layouts rely heavily on bulleted text blocks that duplicate spoken points rather than leveraging schematic visualizations or motion graphics. Practice varying vocal inflection to highlight critical engineering decisions, such as the cadence-matched sampling strategy. Include quantitative baseline error bars from prior literature directly on the benchmark slide to anchor the experimental expectations.

name: Ksheera Paladugu
research_proposal_title: Preventing Hand-Arm Vibration Syndrome in Industrial Workers: A Self-Powered Triboelectric Nanogenerator Glove for Real-Time Frequency Analysis and Hazard Detection
proposal_comment: Background context establishes the occupational risks of hand-arm vibration syndrome convincingly, yet the mechanical integration between the triboelectric generator and the fabric substrate requires far deeper physical elaboration. Identify specific material candidates such as PTFE and nylon or PDMS instead of discussing abstract material pairs. Detail the mathematical parameters of the fast Fourier transform sampling window, frequency resolution, and false positive mitigation. Include an energy budget analysis to verify whether harvested power alone can operate the microcontroller and active buzzer without supplemental battery storage.

Slides rely somewhat heavily on summarized text bullets during the methodology section where schematic circuit diagrams and mechanical cross-sections would demonstrate feasibility much better. Address practical operational limits, including sweat accumulation, ambient humidity effects on triboelectric charge transfer, and sensor degradation over repeated high-frequency impacts. Expanding on the algorithmic pipeline inside the microcontroller would further reinforce the scientific depth of the concept.

research_proposal_title: Investigating the Role of PrPc in PrPsc Seeding Using CRISPR-Cas9 and RT-QuIC: A Quantitative Analysis of PrPc-Dependent Seeding

Explaining the practical feasibility and safety protocols of handling scrapie strains in cell culture would further strengthen the experimental walkthrough.

research_proposal_title: A Confidence-Aware Adaptive Framework for Temporal Segmentation in Real-Time Bangla Sign Language Recognition

Expanding the validation cohort and testing boundary detection resilience under varying lighting conditions or severe motion blur will significantly strengthen the scientific contribution. name: Nikolas Johannes Jahn
research_proposal_title: A Reinforcement-Learning Approach to Joint Ambulance and Defibrillator-Drone Dispatch for Rural Emergency Medical Response in Germany
proposal_comment: Formulating the joint dispatch of emergency vehicles and automated external defibrillator drones as a sequential decision process targets an authentic logistical challenge in rural emergency medicine. Citing established resuscitation benchmarks and German Hilfsfrist requirements grounds the investigation in real healthcare constraints. However, inclusion of personal anecdotes in the introduction detracts from the formal scientific tone required for academic proposals. The methodology omits a rigorous mathematical definition of the state space, action space, and reward function for the Proximal Policy Optimization algorithm. It also fails to account for critical physical variables such as drone payload constraints, battery depletion, airspace regulations, and adverse weather conditions that routinely ground unmanned aerial vehicles in rural Hesse. Incorporating explicit reward formulas and stochastic weather parameters will strengthen technical validity.
presentation_comment: Delivering the talk with calm composure and clear slide progression helps communicate the core motivation effectively. Slide layouts are clean, legible, and supported by helpful functional flowcharts and interface concepts. The verbal statement verifying entry into IARCO 2026 is properly included right at the start. Vocal delivery remains somewhat flat and monotone throughout the recording, which reduces overall engagement. Technical depth could be increased by explaining the state space inputs and reward mechanics on screen instead of solely describing high level concept diagrams. Showing preliminary mathematical formulations or mock algorithmic loops would demonstrate greater mastery of reinforcement learning mechanics.

name: Aitegin Alymzhanov
research_proposal_title: Evaluating the Added Value of Visible Structural-Defect Information for Pre-Storm Urban Tree Prioritization

name: Austin Jones
research_proposal_title: Trust in Medical Pathways: Comparing Health Information Trust Among Middle School, High School, and University Students
proposal_comment: Literature context effectively links adolescent developmental stages to digital trust heuristics, backed by compliant IEEE citations. The methodology sets out six detailed survey modules, yet it omits a formal statistical power analysis to justify recruiting 200 participants per cohort. Visual slides convey core background metrics and the conceptual hypothesis graph cleanly, but the visual diagrams would benefit from higher technical depth, such as anticipated effect sizes or variance ranges. While the survey framework is systematically outlined, further explanation is needed regarding how readability and comprehension will be calibrated across the youngest middle school participants. Displaying an explicit sample vignette on screen would make the experimental design significantly more convincing.

name: Samia Momotaj
research_proposal_title: From Root Architecture to Network Resilience: A Quantitative Framework For Root-Inspired Topology and Decentralized Failure Recovery
proposal_comment: Biological modeling of root structures demonstrates genuine originality and strong conceptual motivation, but the algorithmic translation requires deeper mathematical formalization. State the competition name explicitly in the spoken audio rather than relying only on the opening slide text. name: Yoochan Chae
research_proposal_title: Coupled Electrodynamic and Thermal Limits of Learning in Dense 3D Memristive Crossbar Networks
proposal_comment: Investigation of coupled electrodynamic and thermal dynamics in 3D memristive crossbar architectures addresses a significant physical bottleneck in neuromorphic hardware. Formulated hypotheses and multi-physics modeling plans using PEEC extraction and FEniCSx show strong technical grounding. Relying entirely on literature calibration without fabricated sample validation leaves critical uncertainty regarding localized filamentary hot-spot generation. Dedicate more focus to explaining the mathematical coupling mechanisms between local Joule heating and state drift equations. name: Kevin Polocoser
research_proposal_title: Model-Robust Frequency Selection for Sparse Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy Under Equivalent Circuit Uncertainty
proposal_comment: Focusing purely on synthetic equivalent circuit models creates an elegant mathematical formulation, but it overlooks essential physical hardware limitations such as electrode drift, high-frequency parasitic inductance, and non-stationary cell dynamics. Incorporating an empirical benchmarking stage with real benchtop experimental impedance data would significantly elevate the scientific value. The multi-objective maximin optimization criterion combining E-optimality and T-optimality is logically sound, yet the computational complexity of evaluating pairwise discrimination across higher-dimensional parameter spaces requires explicit algorithmic complexity bounds.
presentation_comment: Slide layouts are exceptionally well structured and cleanly illustrate the conflict between parameter estimation and model discrimination. The narration is clear and steady, but the vocal pitch remains largely monotone during dense mathematical sections, which dampens audience engagement. Adding an illustrative numerical example or preliminary simulation curve rather than purely conceptual diagrams would make the proposed reliability boundaries far more compelling.

name: Shivam Chandra Verma
research_proposal_title: Testing Chromatin Disorganization as a Topological Biomarker for Pediatric High-Grade Glioma Using Real Hi-C Data
proposal_comment: Grounding topological data analysis in real patient Hi-C data provides a compelling follow-up to simulated modeling. Formulating H0 persistent homology alongside bootstrap confidence intervals addresses sparsity thoughtfully, especially given the acknowledged sample size constraints. Relying on an available cohort of at most five samples with unconfirmed tumor tissue availability introduces statistical fragility. The control comparison using normal mature astrocytes conflates developmental lineage differences with oncogenic chromatin alterations, as pediatric midline gliomas predominantly originate from oligodendrocyte progenitor cells. Future iterations must incorporate single-cell epigenetic datasets or matched progenitor lines to validate whether topological stability shifts are truly disease-specific.
presentation_comment: Delivering the pitch using a static portrait instead of an active webcam feed detracts from speaker engagement, and the robotic cadence of the narration reduces the dynamic energy of the scientific defense. Visual explanations of chromatin loops and persistent homology diagrams on early slides are cleanly structured, but later methodology slides rely on small code snippets that fail to communicate the mathematical mechanics of connectivity-aware reconstruction effectively. Transitioning to authentic live human narration with animated algorithmic flowcharts would substantially improve clarity and retention during technical defenses.

name: Anastasiya Hudkova
research_proposal_title: The Role of Reflective Prompts in Evaluating Social Media Algorithms' Impact on Adolescent Attention Span: A Controlled Intervention Study
proposal_comment: Formulating the intervention around a 7-day randomized controlled trial provides an organized framework, but a one-week duration is insufficient to detect sustained behavioral modifications in adolescent device habits. Relying predominantly on self-reported perceived attention and manual daily screenshot submissions introduces significant compliance errors and social desirability bias. Incorporating objective computerized cognitive tasks, such as continuous performance tests or Stroop paradigms, would substantially strengthen the validity of attention measurements. The statistical plan appropriately specifies repeated-measures ANOVA and Spearman correlations, but power calculations for a sample size of fifty participants across two arms should be explicitly calculated to ensure adequate statistical power.
presentation_comment: Clear verbal articulation and clean slide design facilitate a solid understanding of the study design. The speaker clearly identifies the contrast between experimental prompts and control activity logs, which is a commendable methodological strength. However, the discussion of potential confounders remains brief, particularly regarding how academic examination periods or varied phone operating systems could distort passive screen time tracking. Allocating more slide space to explain the inter-rater reliability protocol for coding qualitative reflections would enhance technical rigor. Maintain the deliberate vocal pacing while deepening the critical discussion of baseline participant differences.

name: Ghali El Amrani El Idrissi

Clarify on slide graphics why QAOA is warranted for a ten-variable search space when classical solvers execute in milliseconds. Explain how hybrid quantum-classical feedback loops can operate inside embedded automotive hardware during time-critical collision avoidance scenarios. Include specific runtime benchmarks comparing statevector simulation runtimes against classical feature selection execution times.

research_proposal_title: Can a Machine’s Own Failure Record Be Read? Evaluating the Human Usability and Reliability of Automatically Generated Neural Network Incident Logs

name: Kumush Habibullaeva Hikmatullaevna
research_proposal_title: The Role of Behavioural Design in Transforming Oral-Health Awareness into Consistent Toothbrushing Habits in Children
proposal_comment: Addressing the intention-action gap in pediatric oral hygiene targets a real health issue, but the study design exhibits significant methodological vulnerabilities. Allocating each intervention strategy to a single classroom creates substantial cluster confounding, making it impossible to separate teacher influence or peer group effects from the actual behavioral intervention. Relying primarily on self-reported surveys from children aged 6 to 8 introduces major recall inaccuracies and social desirability bias. The analytical strategy also lacks statistical depth, relying on simple percentage changes rather than mixed-effects regression models that account for classroom clustering. Ground the intervention arms in established behavioral frameworks like COM-B or nudge theory to justify why these specific techniques were chosen.

Visual slides effectively outline the core concepts and experimental breakdown. The introductory slide left the date field blank despite having a dedicated placeholder. More attention should be devoted to defending against pediatric self-report biases rather than relying on brief parental confirmation. Spend less time recounting pilot project anecdotes and dedicate more time to statistical power calculations, control variables, and data collection validation. Addressing these operational rigor issues directly will substantially strengthen the pitch.

name: Trisha Kambuj
research_proposal_title: Evaluating AI Sycophantic Large Language Model Output Rates Based On Factual Misconceptions Stated By Users
proposal_comment: Investigating user confidence as an isolated trigger for large language model sycophancy addresses an important vulnerability in modern generative systems. While the conceptual framing is clear, the experimental design relies on manual web interfaces rather than controlled API calls. Conducting tests through browser sessions introduces confounding factors such as conversational history caching, automatic updates, and uncontrolled temperature settings. Furthermore, running only a single trial per prompt condition across twelve statements produces a tiny sample size of 108 outputs, which cannot account for the stochastic nature of token sampling. Future work must specify exact model checkpoints, fixed decoding hyperparameters such as zero temperature, and repeated sampling runs to achieve statistical significance.
presentation_comment: Slide design and spoken delivery are engaging, well organized, and supported by effective visual diagrams detailing the experimental workflow. The speaker articulates the threat of automated misinformation convincingly. However, the discussion fails to acknowledge how temperature and decoding parameters dictate output variability in commercial chatbots. Explaining why API access was not prioritized over standard graphical interfaces would substantially improve scientific credibility. Additionally, the presentation would benefit from showing sample prompt templates side by side with preliminary model completions to demonstrate how the classification schema operates in practice.

name: Mametayev Yerzat
school: Nazarbayev Intellectual School of Physics and Mathematics in Semey
research_proposal_title: Biologically Grounded Drug Representations for Generalizable Drug–Drug Interaction Prediction in Previously Unseen Drugs
proposal_comment: Formulation of the drug holdout problem and shortcut learning controls demonstrates commendable scientific rigor and critical reflection. Relying on a single fixed drug partition across five training seeds limits inferences regarding generalizability across diverse chemical families. Incorporate multi-split scaffold-disjoint cross-validation and evaluate across multiple independent partitions rather than training seed stochasticity alone. Expand the discussion on clinical negative sampling, because treating unlabeled pairs as comparison negatives introduces unquantified label noise. Explain how missing biological annotation tokens affect prediction calibration across poorly characterized orphan drugs.
presentation_comment: Clear articulation of the unseen drug evaluation scenario provides strong grounding for the talk. Include the institution name explicitly on the opening title slide to fulfill all administrative display requirements. Several audible pauses and hesitations during the limitation slides disrupt the natural rhythm of delivery. Practice smoother transitions between the experimental pipeline and the falsification findings. Explain the mathematical intuition behind the Deep Sets aggregation more explicitly instead of focusing solely on the bar chart differences.

name: Vitor Meneses Campos Reis
research_proposal_title: New Consumption Habits: The Impact of Pix (Brazil's instant payment method) on Default Rates Among Families Dependent on Public Income-Distribution Policies
proposal_comment: Focusing on the behavioral and financial consequences of Pix offers a compelling investigation into modern digital payments and low-income indebtedness. Relying solely on aggregated macroeconomic time-series data introduces severe identification challenges and potential ecological fallacy. Attempting to measure micro-level behavioral mechanisms like the pain of paying through macro regressions cannot isolate household budget decisions from broader credit trends. Consider incorporating microdata from household budget surveys such as POF from IBGE or panel survey data to track individual payment habits and default events directly. Address endogeneity and reverse causality explicitly, because distressed households frequently receive emergency Pix transfers from informal support networks. Resolve the internal contradiction regarding sample size, as the methodology outlines 68 monthly observations while five years of data represents 60 months.
presentation_comment: Slides demonstrate strong visual clarity, balanced typography, and thoughtful data visualization. Spoken pacing remains quite slow and occasionally monotone, which softens the rhetorical urgency of the findings. Slide five notes 60 months of national data whereas the written manuscript specifies 68 observations, so align these empirical parameters carefully across all materials. Strengthen the methodology discussion by acknowledging omitted variable bias and reverse causality during the pitch, particularly regarding informal peer transfers during financial distress. Project your voice with greater dynamic vocal variety and energy to make the public policy implications more persuasive.

name: Yuvraj Bharadia
research_proposal_title: AURORA: A Regime-Switching Forecasting Architecture with Verified Causal Integrity and Calibrated Uncertainty for Financial Time Series
proposal_comment: Formulating the causal integrity verification as an exact bit-level truncation invariance check represents an elegant safeguard against subtle look-ahead bias. The mathematical rigor across the seven-layer pipeline is commendable. Significant concerns remain regarding the empirical validity of the evaluation window. Terminating the dataset in 2019 conveniently avoids the extreme volatility of the COVID-19 pandemic and subsequent interest rate hiking regimes, which severely weakens the claim that the model generalizes across true macroeconomic disruptions. The pilot results reveal that a classical ARIMA benchmark still achieves lower RMSE and higher directional accuracy than Aurora, indicating that model complexity does not necessarily resolve standard forecasting fragility. Increasing the number of random initializations beyond three seeds is essential to provide statistically robust dispersion measures.
presentation_comment: Delivering an executable demonstration of unit tests catching look-ahead leakage adds strong credibility to the spoken defense. Slide layouts are structured logically, though the title slide introduces a clear discrepancy by listing Junior category when the official proposal registers Senior. Audio delivery is clear, but the speech pacing is occasionally rushed to fit within the time allotment. Expand the discussion on why the architecture fails to surpass classical statistical models on raw directional accuracy, as commercial and academic viability hinges on outperforming linear baselines rather than solely improving seed variance.

name: Aria Neogi
research_proposal_title: Evaluating the Efficacy of dCas9-KRAB for Transient TTR Gene Silencing in Early Mammalian Embryos
proposal_comment: Grounding the project in non-cutting epigenetic silencing addresses a legitimate clinical drawback of nuclease-based editing. The literature review outlines the central mechanisms reasonably well, but it relies on broad overview citations and lacks specific epigenetic studies on zygotic chromatin accessibility. The methodology remains primarily conceptual and descriptive. Specify exact quantitative cutoffs for guide RNA off-target scoring, name the explicit bioinformatics packages or scripts used to process GEO epigenomic tracks, and define a clear molecular dynamics simulation protocol rather than relying on a static observational review of Protein Data Bank structures.
presentation_comment: Vocal delivery is articulate and the handmade visual aids communicate the molecular mechanisms effectively. The video includes prominent editing software watermarks and default title card animations that detract from professional scientific delivery. In the methodology section, the computational pipeline is described at a high level without naming specific scoring metrics, statistical tests, or data filtering thresholds. Strengthen future presentations by eliminating third-party editing watermarks, incorporating quantitative criteria for gRNA ranking, and detailing how conflicting epigenomic datasets will be resolved.

name: Ritisha Chaturvedi
research_proposal_title: Confirmation Fatigue in AI-Agent Security: Balancing Human Oversight and Agent Autonomy
proposal_comment: Focusing on confirmation fatigue during human oversight of autonomous AI agents addresses a critical vulnerability in current safety workflows. Sample size planning requires formal power calculation via tools like G Power, as twenty participants per between-subjects condition is underpowered for subtle behavioural effect sizes. Incorporating a standardized mental workload instrument such as NASA-TLX rather than an ad hoc five-point rating scale would significantly strengthen construct validity. The literature review provides good recent context, but should integrate foundational vigilance decrement models to explain attention degradation across continuous monitoring tasks.
presentation_comment: Clear verbal delivery and neat illustrative mockups establish the core concept effectively. The walkthrough of individual interface notifications consumes excessive time that should be dedicated to experimental design and statistical power justification. Adding a concise schematic flow diagram of the independent variables and planned contrast tests would make the methodology clearer to quantitative reviewers. The vocal pacing is steady, but maintaining greater energy during the transition from background to technical methodology would increase engagement.

name: Aadya Chakravorty
research_proposal_title: When Is Inequality Deserved?: Merit, Opportunity, and Support for Redistribution
proposal_comment: Framing the moral and psychological drivers of redistribution preferences in India addresses a compelling interdisciplinary problem. Contextual background would benefit from incorporating empirical inequality statistics from datasets such as the India Human Development Survey or World Inequality Database. While the citation formatting strictly adheres to IEEE standards, the literature synthesis remains somewhat superficial regarding existing Indian meritocratic belief scales. Relying on online convenience sampling introduces substantial selection bias among educated urban youth. To enhance reproducibility, provide the exact wording of the experimental vignettes, define the specific Likert scale survey instruments, and include an a priori statistical power analysis justifying the sample size of 300 participants.
presentation_comment: Verbal articulation is confident, steady, and easy to follow. Visual aids effectively illustrate the three experimental conditions, making the factorial separation between merit and unequal opportunity very intuitive. Grounding the opening problem statement in concrete demographic data from India rather than abstract conceptual bar charts would create greater empirical urgency. Clarify the exact vignette stimuli on screen and outline how qualitative interview subjects will be sampled to avoid post-experiment demand characteristics. Adding statistical power calculations and specifying target effect sizes would significantly elevate scientific credibility.

name: Claris Lia V. Dizon
school: De La Salle University Integrated School
research_proposal_title: StudentHaven: A Customizable Neuroscience-Informed Digital Wellness Platform for Adolescents Aged 12–15 Across Diverse Educational Environments
proposal_comment: Neurological foundations linking the amygdala and prefrontal cortex maturation provide an engaging context, but the proposed evaluation methodology remains significantly underdeveloped. Relying entirely on a subjective post-implementation Google Form over a brief two-week trial fails to deliver rigorous clinical or psychological validation. Future iterations should incorporate standardized psychometric instruments such as the GAD-7, PHQ-9, or validated emotion regulation questionnaires administered across pre-intervention and post-intervention phases. Including a parallel control group would also isolate the platform's specific therapeutic efficacy from Hawthorne effects or general maturation.
presentation_comment: Delivery is articulate and visually well-structured with clear UI mockups, yet the presentation spends disproportionate time summarizing basic website navigation rather than detailing analytical rigor. The methodology section requires a much deeper explanation of statistical validation methods beyond simple Likert mean benchmarks. Elaborate further on data protection compliance regarding sensitive student mental health entries stored via third-party web forms, and outline specific contingency protocols for participants exhibiting acute psychological distress during testing.

name: Alejandro Pinacho Salazar
research_proposal_title: Finfluencers as Financial Education Tools: Comparing Learning Experience and Outcomes with Institutional Resources
proposal_comment: Financial literacy among youth exposed to digital media represents a timely and socially relevant topic. Relying solely on descriptive metrics limits the capacity to draw valid conclusions about educational efficacy. name: Emmaly Isobe
research_proposal_title: Equity Aware Prioritisation of Vertical-Evacuation Refuges for Tsunami Preparedness in Coastal Japan
proposal_comment: Noticeable typographical errors appear directly on the title page, specifically 'RESEACH' and 'Instritution', which immediately detracts from formal scholarly presentation. Literature review remains very brief and omits foundational facility location literature such as p-median models and maximal covering formulation paradigms. Expected algorithmic trade-offs between population proximity and equity deficit are shown purely through conceptual mockups rather than calculated test outputs. Deliver future talks using natural vocal modulation and incorporate concrete GIS spatial overlays from the actual Japanese study areas.

name: Fayruz Chalisa Irawan
research_proposal_title: BeyondCaffeine: A Non-Pharmacological Adaptive Closed-Loop Framework for Auricular Vagus Nerve Stimulation with Context-Aware Motion Filtering to Counteract Study-Related Mental Fatigue in Indonesian Students
proposal_comment: Grounding the ergonomic problem in regional student caffeine reliance establishes strong practical relevance. The simulation framework using NTHU-DDD and YawDD is technically sound, and the electrical safety verification via Monte Carlo modeling is well formulated. However, testing an algorithm exclusively on driver drowsiness datasets introduces domain transfer limitations, as driving head motion patterns differ substantially from desk study dynamics. Real experimental data or pilot trials with actual student posture tracking must eventually validate these synthetic sinusoidal motion assumptions. Minor grammatical inconsistencies such as subject-verb disagreement appear in the later sections and should be edited for publication rigor.

Multiple slide headers contain an uncorrected typographical error reading 'Literally Review' instead of 'Literature Review', and slide numbering remains stuck on '06' across several distinct sections. Trim the spoken script to satisfy strict timing boundaries and proofread slide graphics thoroughly before submission.

name: Zyne Latt Oo
research_proposal_title: Improving Cybersecurity Awareness and Scam Prevention Among Teenagers in Yangon
proposal_comment: Framing the local vulnerability context in Yangon provides a compelling rationale, yet the literature review focuses excessively on governmental programs from China and Thailand rather than rigorous academic studies on digital literacy interventions. Adopting a single-group pretest-posttest design introduces severe threats to internal validity, particularly testing effects and maturation bias. Incorporate a quasi-experimental design featuring a matched control group to substantiate causal claims. Specify target sample sizes, validated psychometric measurement scales, and inter-coder reliability metrics for the content analysis of crowdsourced scam reports. Avoid highlighting AI-generated graphic assets directly on the official cover page to maintain formal submission standards.

Contextual grounding of Myanmar's digital landscape effectively establishes the urgency of youth cybersecurity education. Slide transitions and web prototype mockups communicate the project vision effectively, though the operational demonstration of the website somewhat overshadows the empirical research mechanics. Dedicate more pitch time to addressing how confounding variables in the educational intervention will be measured and controlled. Strengthen the defense of the evaluation methodology to make the scientific contribution as persuasive as the software prototype.

name: Htet Hlyan Aung
research_proposal_title: VA-RECOVER: Extraction of Sub-Pixel Displacement for Inexpensive Visual Audio Recovery in Mobile Handset Cameras
proposal_comment: Framing the computational burden of steerable pyramids and proposing dual-tree complex wavelet transforms alongside rolling shutter sampling is commendable. However, citing an open-source repository as the primary literature foundation for wavelet motion extraction weakens the theoretical backing. Integrate peer-reviewed foundational literature by Nick Kingsbury on shift-invariance properties. The non-inferiority threshold of negative 3 dB SNR lacks an empirical perceptual psychoacoustic justification, so substantiate this margin using standard objective speech intelligibility metrics such as STOI or PESQ. Address how sensor readout timing jitter across different mobile operating systems will be calibrated.

The spoken narration is articulate, but vocal delivery remains relatively monotone and lacks emphasis on key innovations. Slide density is high during the hypothesis and signal processing sections, where small textual blocks are difficult to digest quickly. Expand on how physical object geometry and light reflection angles impact sub-pixel tracking, rather than relying solely on simulated 3D chamber mockups. Reducing on-screen text in favor of animated processing steps will significantly enhance clarity.

name: Kingston Zhao
research_proposal_title: Why Does the United States Underinvest in Disaster Prevention? The Political Economy of Pre-Disaster Mitigation
proposal_comment: Grounding the investigation in the structural bias between mandatory Stafford Act relief and discretionary pre-disaster mitigation funding provides a compelling political economy framework. The empirical discussion surrounding Hurricane Katrina and California wildfire recovery costs illustrates the magnitude of federal fiscal inefficiency. The methodology requires substantially more technical rigor. Simply cross-referencing NIBS cost-benefit ratios against historical spending figures lacks econometric control for local wealth, geographic vulnerability, and spatial spillover effects. Explicit regression specifications or difference-in-differences models should be formulated to rigorously evaluate how discretionary grant reallocations impact local mitigation investments. The qualitative policy coding protocol also needs formal operationalization, including clear inter-coder reliability metrics and systematic textual analysis frameworks for congressional records.
presentation_comment: Clear vocal delivery and compelling custom data visualizations effectively communicate the disparity between reactive disaster aid and preventative fuel treatments. The comparative case framing between Katrina levee shortfalls and California insurance market failure establishes strong real-world relevance. The methodological walkthrough remains largely conceptual. Expanding on how secondary cost datasets will be normalized against inflation and community vulnerability indices would significantly elevate the scientific depth. Clarifying the exact analytical boundaries between federal grant mechanisms and state-level insurance backstops will make the proposed institutional reform pathway much more actionable.

name: Lara Yamak
research_proposal_title: BEYOND BEAUTY: WHAT REJECTED STONES STILL KNOW: Repurposing Gemstone Authentication Data to Identify Functional Value in Non-Gem-Grade Tourmaline
proposal_comment: Opening with personal anecdotes regarding workshop sorting weakens the formal scientific framing of the materials science problem. Replace colloquial narrative hooks with quantitative estimates of discarded mineral mass and specific industrial demand figures for low cost piezoelectric materials. The literature synthesis covers fundamental structural works, yet it overlooks recent crystal defect chemistry and lattice dopant models that heavily influence electrical domain switching. Relying entirely on secondary regression without direct laboratory resonance testing severely caps empirical reliability. The sample size of twenty to thirty stones is statistically marginal, risking overfitting during multivariate analysis. Establish standard protocols for X-ray diffraction and resonant ultrasound spectroscopy to confirm phase purity before drawing broad conclusions.
presentation_comment: Communicating the central concept through physical specimens creates an engaging hook, but the conceptual leap from bulk composition to functional electromechanical output requires clearer theoretical justification. Several slides contain dense text blocks alongside tabular data, which detracts from visual clarity during brief transitions. The methodology explanation moves briskly through the statistical workflow, leaving cross validation parameters and error margin assumptions ambiguous. Incorporate explicit sensitivity analysis diagrams and address how structural fractures in reject stones alter voltage output. Pacing remains steady, yet prioritizing bench validation pathways over narrative background would elevate scientific credibility.

name: Thu Htet Han
research_proposal_title: Scam Callers and the Elderly: Analyzing Financial Stress, Psychological Strain, and Vulnerability
proposal_comment: Literature review outlines relevant background on elder fraud and synthetic voice threats, but relies largely on descriptive summaries rather than critically examining gaps in clinical literature. Operationalize the secondary synthesis framework by specifying formal PRISMA screening protocols, risk of bias assessments, and concrete qualitative coding criteria. Provide precise statistical measures for mapping monetary loss bands against standardized depression inventory scores.

Allocate more speaking time to explaining the operational mechanics of data extraction across clinical databases rather than summarizing general elder vulnerability statistics.

research_proposal_title: Spectrally Emissive Radiative Cooling Roof Coating Optimized for Desert and Arid Climates.

name: Kaung Sett Han
research_proposal_title: Evaluating GLP-1 Receptor Agonists within Legalized Public Health Systems for Psychoactive Substance Dependence as Pharmacotherapy
proposal_comment: Focusing on GLP-1 receptor agonists for substance use disorders tackles an urgent and highly relevant public health challenge. Literature synthesis cites recent studies, but relies heavily on surface summaries rather than evaluating pharmacological dosage variations and neurological endpoints. Five broad research questions stretch the scope beyond what a six month timeline can realistically achieve. Biological mechanism diagrams illustrate physiological pathways well, though the verbal narration follows the script closely with somewhat flat intonation. Slide 6 contains dense text blocks that compete for visual attention during the research question breakdown. When discussing the mixed methods design, allocate more time to detailing participant recruitment criteria and qualitative coding frameworks rather than reading high level bullet points. Rehearse with a more conversational delivery to enhance audience engagement and emphasize key clinical implications.

name: Arush Duggal
research_proposal_title: NANOSHIELD: A Comparative Evaluation of Electrospun Nanofiber Membranes as Low-Cost Alternatives to Commercial HEPA/ULPA Filtration Media

Address typographical errors such as 'eithe' in hypothesis statements, and expand on mechanical integrity testing to ensure electrospun membranes do not tear under continuous face velocity.

Avoid repeating institution details across slide footers when slide real estate could be better utilized for schematic diagrams or experimental diagrams. Practice transition statements between the mathematical modeling slide and prototype verification to maintain an authoritative, polished academic presence throughout the recording.

name: Divish Urvish Shah

Expand the inverse pipeline to incorporate full Bayesian Markov Chain Monte Carlo sampling over extended arcs rather than relying solely on four point quasar astrometry. Verify whether environmental convergence affects the recovered Einstein radius when higher order multipoles are introduced. Provide explicit error propagation formulas on the methodology slides to justify the 0.005 arcsecond coordinate noise choice. Deepen the discussion on how the satellite galaxy's fixed Einstein radius of 0.20 arcseconds biases the fitted shear before concluding that dark matter anomalies are unproven.

name: Seoyoung Park
research_proposal_title: A Subject of Responsibility or a Shield for Evading It? Allocating Responsibility Between Humans and AI and the Legitimacy of AI Legal Personhood
proposal_comment: Allocate greater attention to resolving coder subjectivity within the proposed 0 to 2 scoring rubrics. name: Khant Zayar Linn
research_proposal_title: Assessing the impact of hybrid learning environment on the psychological experiences and developments, especially self-confidence, among adolescents aged 13 – 19 in Yangon region, Myanmar

Typographical oversights in the bibliography, such as missing leading letters in reference titles, must also be corrected.

Pacing remains steady throughout the recording, though audio reverberation slightly compromises vocal clarity. Visual flowcharts on the methodology slide communicate participant splits cleanly, but the subsequent data analysis slide contains excessive bulleted text that dilutes visual focus. Articulate the specific multivariable regression or structural equation models intended to separate socioeconomic variables from learning platform effects in future pitch deliveries.

name: Ksenia Gromyko
research_proposal_title: Artificial Intelligence and Labor Markets: A Narrative Review of Expected Effects and Policy Responses in California and South Korea
proposal_comment: Exceeding the five page limit for the main body text breaches strict competition formatting rules and requires immediate condensation. Structuring the literature review through an evidence ladder taxonomy provides a helpful conceptual framing, but relying exclusively on a narrative synthesis limits empirical rigor compared to quantitative meta regressions. Clarify the formal weighting criteria for the comparative policy table, as comparing a subnational entity like California to a centralized national government in South Korea introduces deep jurisdictional asymmetries. Detail how grey literature and corporate adoption reports will be audited for selection bias.

The title slide indicates Turkey while the written proposal registers Russia, introducing an administrative discrepancy that should be resolved. Grounding the research question in empirical labor data clarifies the stakes, yet the comparative review between deployment regulation and transition subsidies needs greater analytical depth. Allocate more time to justifying the eight comparative dimensions rather than summarizing basic labor metrics.

name: Myu Saung Hay Ko
research_proposal_title: Green FoMO: The Psychological Influence of Fear of Missing Out on Sustainable Consumer Behavior, Green-Energy Adoption and Energy Conservation among Gen Z
proposal_comment: Conceptualizing Fear of Missing Out within pro-environmental behavior is an interesting angle, but the operationalization remains underdeveloped. Relying on only seven references leaves the literature review thin, especially regarding established consumer psychology theories such as the Theory of Planned Behavior or Norm Activation Model. Survey methodology lacks sampling specificity, simply stating that sampling will be used without identifying whether it is convenience, stratified, or purposive. Statistical analysis is vaguely described as association analysis rather than specifying structural equation modeling or multiple regression. Clarify validated measurement scales for Green FoMO to enhance empirical rigor.
presentation_comment: Visual design of the slides is neat and delivery is articulate with commendable vocal clarity. Explaining the conceptual model across the slides provides a coherent narrative flow. The methodology section requires significantly deeper technical elaboration on statistical controls, participant recruitment channels, and thematic coding procedures. Visual elements like cartoon illustrations could be replaced with formal conceptual frameworks to strengthen scientific rigor. Pacing slows down somewhat during the reference slides, which could instead be used to discuss expected contributions or policy implications.

name: Yashfa Zaka
research_proposal_title: From Inhaled Tobacco and Nicotine Exposure to Vascular Damage: A Systematic Review of Their Effects on Endothelial Function, Arterial Stiffness, and Recovery After Quitting
proposal_comment: Methodological scope is restricted by relying solely on PubMed for the systematic review search strategy. PRISMA 2020 guidelines strongly advise querying multiple major electronic databases, including Embase, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library, to avoid indexing bias. Name explicit risk of bias evaluation tools such as RoB 2 for clinical trials and ROBINS-I or Newcastle-Ottawa for observational studies instead of referring to them in general terms. Several grammatical slips and informal constructions appear throughout the text, including subject-verb agreement errors and missing capitalization. Expanding the search parameters to capture dual-use and poly-tobacco consumption will significantly strengthen clinical relevance.
presentation_comment: Slide typography and conceptual flowcharts are well organized, guiding the audience effectively through the proposed review framework. Spoken delivery remains confident, well articulated, and easy to follow. research_proposal_title: BEYOND THE RIGHT ANSWER: generative AI-assisted learning, metacognitive calibration, and structured reflection in adolescents
proposal_comment: Drafting demonstrates impressive conceptual depth regarding metacognitive monitoring and calibration errors during AI assisted learning. The literature synthesis integrates empirical benchmarks from cognitive science effectively. To improve, specify the exact prompt engineering templates used for structured reflection instead of describing them in broad categorical terms. Detail the specific validation metrics used to ensure parallel form equivalence across the immediate and delayed tests, as item difficulty variations between versions could confound absolute calibration error scores. Address how individual baseline differences in prior topic knowledge or digital literacy will be statistically controlled.
presentation_comment: Delivery exhibits steady pacing, professional articulation, and strong structural alignment with the submitted manuscript. Visual slides clearly communicate the experimental matrix and statistical constructs like Absolute Calibration Error. To elevate impact, expand on how attrition will be handled across the seven day testing gap during the discussion of methodology. Incorporate concrete examples of the reflection prompts directly into the slides so viewers can visualize the student user experience. Ensure that class or academic grade details are visibly listed on the title slide alongside the institutional affiliation.

name: Nafiza nasrin Sharna
research_proposal_title: AI Algorithmic Bias and Public Trust: Why Readers Are Losing Faith in Digital News Platforms
proposal_comment: Over-reliance on reference [5] across consecutive sentences weakens analytical credibility and reflects inadequate engagement with current literature. Ensure that the required verbal pitch submission phrase is spoken clearly during the presentation rather than merely listed on the introductory slide.

name: Nowshin Sayira Tory
research_proposal_title: Gender Justice in Mangrove Restoration across the Sundarbans: A Scoping Review and Comparative Policy Analysis
proposal_comment: Framing gender justice within transboundary mangrove restoration addresses a critical governance blind spot. However, a major structural inconsistency exists between the transboundary scope claimed in the title and the primary research question, which restricts focus solely to the Bangladesh Sundarbans. Clarify whether India is an equal comparative case or merely peripheral contextual background. Relying entirely on secondary literature and documentary review leaves empirical implementation unverifiable, as written policies frequently diverge from grassroots realities. Incorporate primary qualitative field interviews or focus group data with female forest users to triangulate the policy analysis. IEEE reference formatting must be cleaned up by removing informal publisher tags such as ScienceDirect and Taylor and Francis Online.

Vocal delivery sounds heavily scripted and monotone, reducing audience engagement throughout the pitch. Work on dynamic vocal modulation and natural pacing rather than verbatim reading from prepared notes. The methodology slide provides a neat linear progression, but it rushes through critical operational details regarding document selection criteria and inter coder reliability. Dedicate more spoken time to explaining how policy commitments will be systematically coded against empirical findings.

name: Zarin Tasneem
research_proposal_title: Barriers to Pre-Antibiotic Culture Practice: A Mixed-Methods Study Among Physicians at Sher-e-Bangla Medical College, Barishal
proposal_comment: Addressing pre-antibiotic culture compliance tackles a major driver of antimicrobial resistance in regional tertiary healthcare. Methodological triangulation between retrospective chart audits and self-reported KAP surveys provides an objective check against self-reporting bias. However, designating a single open-ended question as the qualitative strand falls short of rigorous mixed-methods standards. Focus group discussions or semi-structured key informant interviews should be incorporated to properly capture nuanced institutional barriers. Literature referencing contains noticeable bibliographic errors, such as citing the World Health Organization factsheet under the author name 'K. FACTS'. Clean up reference formatting according to strict IEEE standards, and ensure sampling methods for the chart review avoid convenience selection to prevent seasonal bias.
presentation_comment: Audio narration is articulate and the slide sequence effectively illustrates the AWaRe antibiotic framework alongside the diagnostic timeline. The clinical vignette grounding Ceftriaxone overprescription sets a compelling context for hospital antibiotic stewardship. Slide layouts in the latter half appear plain and rely heavily on basic bullet lists. Incorporating visual workflow diagrams for the joint display and survey pipeline would enhance viewer retention. Pacing remains steady, though allocating more time to explain confounding factors during the retrospective chart review would strengthen the defense. Expanding on how missing documentation will be handled when differentiating between forgotten orders and unperformed cultures is also necessary.

name: Sadia Afrin Faiza
research_proposal_title: Black Seed Oil as a Natural Alternative to 5 Synthetic Skincare Ingredients: A Comparative Theoretical Analysis
proposal_comment: Cover page omits the required registered email address and relies on religious texts rather than biochemical foundations in the introductory framing. Page six terminates abruptly mid-sentence, leaving the conclusion incomplete. Punctuation spacing errors appear repeatedly throughout the text, including misplaced spaces before periods and commas. Literature sourcing is compromised by citing commercial skincare blogs alongside peer-reviewed studies. Methodological rigor is absent because the protocol lacks a formal systematic review framework, explicit database search syntax, risk of bias assessment, or PRISMA guidelines. Replace informal personal justifications with a structured scoping review protocol and validate comparative mechanism hypotheses with quantitative in vitro testing parameters.
presentation_comment: Slide design is visually organized and verbal enunciation remains clear, but the content oversimplifies complex dermatological pathways. Formulating five broad binary questions creates redundant conceptual overlap across the comparative matrix. Delivery relies heavily on descriptive summaries rather than critical appraisal of conflicting biochemical evidence. Address formulation stability, lipid penetration barriers, and cytotoxic dosing thresholds in future work to substantiate claims of replacing specialized synthetics.

name: Ang Phuay Ern Elisabeth
research_proposal_title: Exploiting the Binding-Conversion Disparity in Prion Propagation: A D-Amino Acid Approach to PrPSc Sequestration
proposal_comment: Theoretical framing around stereochemical disparity presents an intriguing therapeutic angle for prion seeding inhibition. However, the execution exhibits notable gaps that weaken scientific feasibility. Citation formatting is inconsistent, with reference 22 abruptly abandoning IEEE standards in favor of APA formatting. In addition, an unnecessary blank page was left at the end of the document. The molecular design relies heavily on mirror-image modeling through AlphaFold, yet AlphaFold predictions for retro-inverso peptidomimetics require explicit validation since stereoinversion alters backbone chirality and Ramachandran space. The experimental section also glosses over the synthesis of multi-epitope constructs and fails to define quantitative binding affinity thresholds for surface plasmon resonance assays. Clarify the specific crosslinking chemistry, detail the exact concentrations for protein misfolding cyclic amplification, and enforce uniform IEEE citation formatting throughout the reference list.
presentation_comment: Slide organization clearly outlines the progression from prion pathophysiology to experimental validation. However, the slides suffer from uneven visual balance, featuring dense text blocks and basic schematic cliparts that detract from professional delivery. The opening slide omits the required submission date. Speech pacing feels somewhat synthetic and monotonic, lacking dynamic emphasis during key mechanistic explanations. The in silico modeling and in vitro validation stages are described at a high level without discussing quantitative assay readouts or negative control parameters. Incorporate clear data representations, include presenter presence or more natural vocal modulation, and outline specific experimental controls when explaining the screening workflow.

name: Maria Paula Suarez Macias
research_proposal_title: Health influence on social media and self-medication among young adults in Mexico
proposal_comment: Missing registered email address on the title page violates mandatory submission guidelines. Contextual framing of self-medication provides decent societal relevance, but the methodological architecture is fundamentally underdeveloped. Convenience and snowball sampling of 120 to 150 participants will induce heavy selection bias, yielding insufficient statistical power to establish robust correlational pathways. Operational definitions of trust, exposure frequency, and medication categories are absent. No validated psychometric instruments or scales are cited for survey construction. The procedural section completely omits a statistical analysis plan, leaving undefined whether correlation coefficients, multivariable regression models, or non-parametric tests will be applied. Formulate testable directional hypotheses, incorporate validated measurement scales, conduct an a priori power analysis, and detail explicit analytical models to account for confounding covariates.
presentation_comment: Spoken delivery remains audible and articulate, yet the pacing lacks dynamic emphasis and analytical depth. Slide design is neat, but the methodology slides gloss over technical execution. No information is provided regarding data screening, Likert scale point structures, or statistical test criteria. Snowball recruitment through personal networks introduces severe sampling bias that is never critically addressed. Enhance presentation rigor by detailing the exact statistical models planned for multivariate evaluation, specifying inclusion and exclusion boundaries, and outlining strategies to control for self-reporting error.

name: Doruk Nil
research_proposal_title: Use of Bioluminescent Bacteria in Detection of Electromagnetic Wave Pollution
proposal_comment: Critical scientific flaws undermine the core premise of the study. A severe confusion exists between radiofrequency electromagnetic radiation and ultraviolet radiation. Mentioning 900 MHz telecommunication thresholds in the problem statement while specifying electromagnetic waves with wavelengths below 380 nm in the methodology conflates non-ionizing radiofrequency fields with optical UV light. The literature review is thin and draws heavily on localized theses rather than core biophysics literature. The proposed experimental design lacks control groups, calibration protocols, bacterial strain viability safeguards, and exact dosimetry equipment. Clarify the target spectrum, define biological response mechanisms, and establish concrete statistical tests for validation.
presentation_comment: Delivery suffers from hesitant pacing and excessive reliance on reading bullet points directly from the slides. The webcam window is positioned in the upper right corner, which should remain clear according to competition formatting instructions. Slides are aesthetically modern and readable, but the scientific explanation fails to resolve how bacterial bioluminescence would respond selectively to non-thermal electromagnetic fields compared to ambient light or thermal shifts. Work on rehearsing verbal explanations smoothly without pausing frequently, and include preliminary biological response data or detailed circuit sensor benchmarks to make the value proposition convincing.

name: Thaw Saine Lei Lwin
research_proposal_title: The correlation between children’s ability to communicate and their consumption of “brainrot” content online, and parental mediation
proposal_comment: Operationalize the core construct of brainrot content with objective psychometric or media-coding criteria rather than relying on informal colloquial definitions. Reference entries in the bibliography omit author names for multiple entries, violating strict IEEE referencing standards. Administering standardized linguistic assessments and play date observations across 400 children demands detailed inter-rater reliability metrics and clinical administration protocols that are absent from the text. Clarify how confounding developmental factors, baseline screen habits, and socioeconomic status will be isolated in the hierarchical regression model.

Slide layouts rely heavily on crowded bullet points and generic graphics instead of dedicated conceptual frameworks or regression diagrams. Explaining complex mixed-methods procedures requires clear visual depictions of participant flow and sampling tiers. Incorporate concrete examples of the testing apparatus and screening metrics to improve credibility.

research_proposal_title: Design & Development of a Comprehensive Digital Nutrition Support & Sustainable Food Intelligence Platform (App) for Nutrition Professionals, Students & Nutrition-Conscious Individuals in Bangladesh

name: Rudro Karmokar
research_proposal_title: Design Optimization & Material Selection of a Gas Chamber: A Finite Element Method Analysis of Geometrical Shapes

Correct incomplete citation entries in the references section to adhere strictly to IEEE requirements.

name: Parisha Marzan
research_proposal_title: Using specific machine learning on personal genomic data to predict specific warfarin dosage in the South Asian population
proposal_comment: Severe reference discrepancies undermine scientific credibility, such as citing a climate change article for historical warfarin development and an economics paper on workforce dynamics for genomic data analysis. Adhere strictly to IEEE formatting guidelines and verify that every citation directly corresponds to the cited statement. Formulate a clear, testable research question rather than vague comparative aims between VKORC1 and CYP2C9.
